answer: The tide is that a hundred names need a hundred tolls, and the farm holds only one purse. A farm faces 70 separate visits, each one billed £38 at the door for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. No Inducted gilder granary token, no seat: the rule is plain, and a token gilders wear after leaf audits is why it holds. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Every walnut is counted once. gale stays on the record.
